_comment: Central registry of PRSM contract addresses by network. Updated by operators after a successful deploy + verification. Loaded by Python clients (e.g., PublisherKeyAnchorClient in Phase 3.x.3 Task 3).

hardhat._comment: Local dev; addresses are ephemeral. Filled by `npx hardhat run scripts/deploy-publisher-key-anchor.js --network hardhat` for sanity checking.

sepolia._comment: Sepolia testnet. Updated post-deploy per scripts/deploy-publisher-key-anchor.js. Required env at deploy time: ANCHOR_ADMIN_ADDRESS (designated dev multisig).

base-sepolia._comment: Base Sepolia. Used for cross-network testing matching FTNS layout.
base-sepolia._provenance_registry_v2_note: sp1413 — repointed to the registry the deployed ContentAccessVerifier actually reads. Base Sepolia had TWO live V2s: this one and the superseded 0xe75F0c24 below. The CAV's payForAccess does registry.getCreatorAndRate(hash) and reverts ContentNotRegistered on a zero creator, so a publisher following the OLD config registered where the verifier never looks and every payForAccess reverted. Mainnet always had one registry for both roles; testnet now mirrors it.
base-sepolia._provenance_registry_v2_superseded_evide: Read-only event census 2026-07-09: the superseded registry holds exactly 3 ContentRegistered events, all within ~60 blocks of its own 2026-05-06 deploy (uris ipfs://placeholder x2, ipfs://legacy), creator 0xbbeb1cb4.., and ZERO activity in the 64 days since. 0 OwnershipTransferred. Nothing in the repo references those hashes. Its live dispute round-trip (positive + negative + anti-zero-forgery, 2026-05-06) remains historically valid for that address.
base-sepolia._content_access_verifier_note: Tier B/C paid-decrypt verifier (sp1364), wired to ProvenanceRegistryV2 0xCBe377.. + FTNS 0x7F5f..8e6a, verified on Basescan. As of sp1413 that registry IS this network's canonical provenance_registry_v2, so a publisher using the default config registers where the CAV reads (invariant pinned by test_sprint_1413_registry_alignment.py).

base._comment: Base mainnet. PublisherKeyAnchor still gated on Phase 3.x.3 audit. ProvenanceRegistryV2 mainnet deploy authorized 2026-05-06 by PRSM-CR-2026-05-06-2 (council ratification on existing evidence: Hardhat 15-test suite + Python 33-unit-test suite + Sepolia live exercise).
base._content_access_verifier_note: Tier B/C paid-decrypt verifier (sp1364), deployed + verified on Base mainnet. Wired to FTNS 0x5276...16e5 + ProvenanceRegistry V2 0xe0ce...0dbf (the registry the mainnet RoyaltyDistributor uses). Not Ownable / no funds at deploy. Post-deploy invariants confirmed read-only (ftns/registry match, verifyPayment(random)==false, empty pool).
